evidence.quote:
Each new crop of tourists goes
to bed at sunrise the day after arrival with stiff necks from looking
up all night. The craters of the moons are visible to the naked eye,
and even a cheap pair of opera glasses can pick out the buildings of
the Deimos Space Station.
evidence.paraphrase: Mars is described as a settled tourist destination with visible moon craters and a space station on Deimos.

evidence.quote:
Just think, Fred, we were way
up there only twelve hours ago.
evidence.paraphrase: Tourists remark on having traveled to Mars from space stations, indicating interplanetary travel.

evidence.quote:
If
not for the glare of city lights on Earth, we wouldn't have had to move
our telescopes to the Moon. If not for the gravel falling out of the
sky on the Moon, making it necessary to resurface the reflectors every
week, we wouldn't have had to move to Mars.
evidence.paraphrase: Dr. Morton explains why observatories were relocated from Earth to the Moon to Mars for better viewing conditions.

evidence.quote:
except for the immense cost of transporting the
equipment, building materials, workmen, and paying us triple time for
working so far from home. Why, did you ever figure the cost of a single
photographic plate?
evidence.paraphrase: The high cost of interplanetary freight makes each photographic plate enormously expensive.

evidence.quote:
At $7.97 per pound dead-weight ... well, you figure
it out.
evidence.paraphrase: Freight from Earth is quoted at a specific per-pound cost, framing the economics of the Mars operation.

evidence.quote:
He proved with his tabulations that,
in this instance, science, in the guise of the law of averages, was
unfortunately against them.
evidence.paraphrase: A scientist uses tabulations and the law of averages to show that beating the casinos is statistically impossible.

evidence.quote:
It's lucky Dr. Morton is a physicist," said one of the
directors. "No astronomer would ever have thought of that.
evidence.paraphrase: A director contrasts a physicist's problem-solving with an astronomer's, highlighting the scheme's unconventional nature.

evidence.quote: Within two days the only people playing at Harvey's were the shills.
evidence.paraphrase: The horoscope publicity scheme causes a casino to lose all its customers within two days.

evidence.quote:
It took the form of an interplanetary telegram from Harvard
Observatory, their parent organization.
evidence.paraphrase: The scheme is disrupted by an interplanetary telegram from the parent organization ordering it stopped.

evidence.quote:
One of the technicians is working on a gadget with a photocell that
closes the shutter on the film when a rocket goes up," Dr. Morton was
saying. "It should cut down the exposure time a great deal.
evidence.paraphrase: A technician is developing a photocell device to automatically close the camera shutter when rockets are launched.

evidence.quote:
If the plates from any one night
are spoiled, we may not be able to duplicate them for a Martian year.
Mankind is preparing the first trip to another star, and the work of
Mars Observatory is necessary to insure the success of that trip.
evidence.paraphrase: The observatory's work is tied to mankind's first interstellar trip, and ruined plates cannot be replaced for a Martian year.

evidence.quote:
The fuels are standard, and I worked
out the trajectories on the computer.
evidence.paraphrase: Dr. Morton computes rocket trajectories on a computer and uses instruments to aim the skyrockets precisely.

evidence.quote:
But the other wobbled off to
the right, landed on the roof of Harvey's bachelor home and burned it
to the ground.
evidence.paraphrase: One of the rigged rockets goes off course and burns down Harvey's home.

evidence.quote:
This will
be one of the brightest objects in the sky, in a few months. It won't
be back again for thousands of years, but it will be around for a good
while. We've just discovered it, and it is our privilege to call it
'Harvey's Comet.'
evidence.paraphrase: The observatory offers to name a newly discovered comet after Harvey as a permanent remembrance.

evidence.quote:
The other men listened to his plan, at
first with shocked horror, then with deep interest and finally in wild
exultation.
evidence.paraphrase: The staff reacts to Dr. Morton's plan with progressing emotions from horror to exultation.
